label: End-of-episode D1 after an unrewarded rare transition from a1 (a1 -> S2, no reward)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2) and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (ep_trial 90-99; essentially zero before trial 90), when the value head is low. Within those trials it is selective for the previous trial having been a1 -> S2 (rare) with no reward (prev_action==1, prev_common==0, prev_reward==0 together carry ~90% of the mass). It almost never fires after rewarded trials, after a2 choices, or after common transitions. Activation rises toward the episode end: tightening the ep_trial cutoff from 90 to 93-95 raises precision from 0.52 to 0.73-0.89 while keeping most of the mass, so the predicate uses cutoff 93. Every variable is observed at D1 (the previous trial outcome plus episode position), so no future variable is used; adding the agent upcoming choice (action==1) did not help. The residual misses are weak activations at D1 after other unrewarded trials late in the episode.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D1: a1 S2 u, a2 S2 u, a1 S2 r) and value (model) (D1: decile 0 (9 ); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=0, phase=GO & ep_dec=0.
